title: Mang Den plateau day
summary: Dak Ke in the first light, then Kon Pring, and grilled chicken with cơm lam in town. Pa Sy is the waterfall when the lake does not already have the day.

stops.name: Dak Ke Lake
stops.note: Walk the shore in the first light, a short drive from the town strip.

stops.name: Kon Pring village
stops.note: Give the nhà rông and the gongs at least an hour, about 3 km or about 5 km along Highway 24.

stops.name: Grilled chicken and lam rice
stops.note: Grilled chicken with cơm lam back in town.

additions.name: Pa Sy Waterfall
additions.note: The forest fall where three streams meet, about 7.5 km, about 9 km, or about 11 km from town.

additions.name: Mang Den church
additions.note: The Virgin Mary statue and the church on Highway 24.

seoTitle: One day on the Mang Den plateau
seoDescription: A Mang Den day: Dak Ke lake, Kon Pring village, and grilled chicken with cơm lam. Pa Sy is the separate waterfall.
